dedupe_keys.name: cnn based topological synthesis of electric power distribution network for wildfire ignition hazard modeling

description: CNN-based topological synthesis of electric power distribution network for wildfire ignition hazard modeling is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jinyan Zhao, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). Electric power infrastructure is an important source of wildfire ignition. The spatial and topological characteristics of power distribution networks, including line locations, lengths, geometry, and connectivity, are critical for spatially resolved wildfire ignition hazard modeling. However, obtaining such information often requires access to proprietary or sensitive critical-infrastructure data, which is highly restrictive. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 15 top-level files (PTH, IPYNB, PY, TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-b5vp-1e61. Keywords: wildfire ignition, synthetic networks, CNN. Published 2026-08-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
